Hero.headline: Frontend Developer
Hero.description: React & TypeScript developer with commercial experience building media workflows, cross-platform interfaces, and internal administration tools.

About.description:
Hi, I'm Xiaonan. 👋

I’m a frontend developer who enjoys building interactive web experiences. 

My main tools are React and TypeScript. I like turning UI designs into working applications, managing complex states, and paying attention to the small details that make interfaces feel smooth and intuitive. 

I also enjoy understanding the bigger picture, so I’ve been exploring how frontend applications connect with backend systems using tools like Prisma and PostgreSQL. 

In my previous frontend role, I collaborated with designers, backend engineers and a mobile team. I’m always looking to build meaningful products.

items.title: Short-Video Platform

highlights: Mounted only the active and adjacent videos while preserving scroll-snap layout with placeholders
Coordinated video, background audio, seeking and shared mute state across the feed

items.title: Job Board Platform
items.description: An authenticated job portal connecting job-seeker and employer workflows to relational data.
highlights: Type-safe relational data with Prisma and PostgreSQL

items.title: Music App
items.description: A web music player with synchronized playback, queue and playlist controls across the interface.
highlights: One synchronized audio engine across the application
Queue, playlist and playback state designed as reusable actions
